title: pp.butterkreuz3-st~
description: `pp.butterkreuz3-st~` is a stereo three-band crossover filter with a relatively flat magnitude response, producing low-, mid-, and high-band signal outputs for the left and right channels. Its two creation arguments set the crossover frequencies, defaulting to 500 Hz and 2000 Hz, and these can also be set with `frequency-1` and `frequency-2` messages.
